ck_agreement_events_source_agent_plan_id.name: ck_agreement_events_source_agent_plan_id
ck_agreement_events_source_agent_plan_id.value:
"agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id" is null or (
    length("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id") = 36
    and substr("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", 9, 1) = '-'
    and substr("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", 14, 1) = '-'
    and substr("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", 19, 1) = '-'
    and substr("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", 24, 1) = '-'
    and length(replace("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", '-', '')) = 32
    and lower(replace("agreement_events"."source_agent_plan_id", '-', '')) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
  )

ck_negotiation_rounds_portal_upload_rese.name: ck_negotiation_rounds_portal_upload_reservation
ck_negotiation_rounds_portal_upload_rese.value:
(
    "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_id" is null
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_expires_at" is null
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_bytes" is null
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_attempts" = "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_accepted" + "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_rejected"
  ) or (
    "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_id" is not null
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_expires_at" is not null
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_reservation_bytes" between 1 and 22020096
    and "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_attempts" = "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_accepted" + "negotiation_rounds"."portal_upload_rejected" + 1
  )
